strategy_contract.status: specified for future feasibility; not executed or enabled
strategy_contract.trial: one intervention at each eligible common-clock PA boundary, correlated trials retained and clustered; not a count of independent recommendations
strategy_contract.population: SP all, between/within separate; RP within-inning short_profile from15.3; no2024 population/model/weight search
strategy_contract.reference: continue the incumbent at the index boundary when legally possible; same frozen subsequent-action policy and terminal handling as research arm
strategy_contract.research: at index boundary, apply existing four-reason two-red rule including A or B, mature observation and fresh-block persistence. Change only if all frozen14.2 value gates and legal/availability/support gates pass; otherwise continue when known safe, abstain if any required evidence unknown
strategy_contract.replacement_law: for this pool-level timing estimand, uniform over predecision nominal RP options with legal and candidate-specific historical/joint-probability support and confirmed availability. No eligible options or unknown availability => abstain; not best-reliever ranking
strategy_contract.value_rule: minimum delta defense xWPA .005; unsupported mass<=.01; MC95 lower>0 and model-bootstrap80 lower>0; original persistence/cooldown/one-alert constraints retained, never loosened for more cases
strategy_contract.subsequent_policy: same versioned joint behavior policy at subsequent legal boundaries for both arms until the fixed half-ending endpoint. Must rebuild/version at common clock before16; original old-clock candidate behavior is not substituted
strategy_contract.primary_endpoint: defense WE at natural end of the current/upcoming half minus defense WE at common anchor; include all intervening plays, IBB and runner events, absorbing game end; same WE version and horizon for both arms
strategy_contract.secondary_endpoint: RE(anchor) - runs conceded from anchor to same half endpoint - RE(endpoint), defense positive; same RE version and terminal convention
strategy_contract.exploratory_endpoint: same-definition next-PA defense WPA only if prespecified in16, reported separately; next_pa nonout and future_ten deviation are observation tasks, never substitutes for strategy WPA/RE24
strategy_contract.methods: direct, SNIPS and doubly robust under the SAME joint action/candidate/observation support; game and pitcher dependence, year/role subgroups, weight and hidden-confounding sensitivity; no simulator-only benefit claim
required_before16: candidate-specific joint propensities and availability at common clock
aligned half-ending actual endpoint adapters and common subsequent policy
forward comparison qualification and adequate strategy events
strategy_contract.minimum_effect: retain original .005 probability-point candidate gate; a positive strategy mean alone cannot promote, cluster interval and robustness required;16 must separately freeze any inferential minimum

interpretation: review completion is a documented no-entry decision when gates fail; bootstrap intervals conditional on observed labels and fixed models do not solve censoring, confounding or candidate availability
methodNotes: 15.4重算既有前推機率／平衡與固定模型條件結果，沒有訓練新模型、依2024改選母體或估策略收益。2024先前已看過且15.3修正標籤後重跑，這輪不是新的獨立確認。
SP沿15.2完整HGB、局間／局中分開；RP沿15.3新增歷史HGB，主要局中短型歷史，其他固定母體只列敏感度。相同豐富欄位檢查，不能移除失衡欄位過關。
主要overlap、次要IPW是不同目標母體。要求SMD≤.1、兩行動ESS≥500、ECE≤.03且無擬合警告，2022／23開發與2024診斷均過；通過也不能證明無隱藏混雜。
初步點支持只用當時母體、過去分格及有效機率；年度／開發資格與拒絕原因是事後研究稽核，不是當時已知特徵、換投時點或歷史預警回放。缺失後續與實際換投不拿來挑可用點。
Brier群聚區間採300次比賽與投手兩組獨立重抽後相乘權重，配對比較模型與其過去常數。只條件於固定模型及已觀測結果，沒有重訓不確定性，也不解決非隨機缺失或多重比較。
缺失者維持未知；觀測加權與odds假設情境不是反事實。下一PA非出局與十球偏離不能替代策略WPA／RE24終點。
16策略契約以同半局終點比較續投與多燈條件換投，接任採固定等機率支持名義RP池，屬時機／池層級研究，不是最佳人選排名；實際可用性及共同後續策略未知時拒絕評估。
